changeSet.author: brian
changeSet.comment: Add report_permission column to stretchy_report for role-based report access

changeSet.author: brian
changeSet.comment: Populate report_permission for all existing reports using READ_<UPPERCASE_UNDERSCORE_NAME> format

changeSet.author: brian
changeSet.comment: Insert standardized report permissions into m_permission
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO m_permission (`grouping`, code, entity_name, action_name, can_maker_checker) SELECT 'report', sr.report_permission, sr.report_name, 'READ', 0 FROM stretchy_report sr WHERE sr.report_permission IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM m_permission p WHERE p.code = sr.report_permission);

changeSet.author: brian
changeSet.comment: Copy role assignments from legacy READ_<report_name> permissions to new standardized codes
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO m_role_permission (role_id, permission_id) SELECT DISTINCT rp.role_id, new_p.id FROM m_role_permission rp INNER JOIN m_permission old_p ON old_p.id = rp.permission_id AND old_p.`grouping` = 'report' INNER JOIN stretchy_report sr ON old_p.code = CONCAT('READ_', sr.report_name) INNER JOIN m_permission new_p ON new_p.code = sr.report_permission WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM m_role_permission rp2 WHERE rp2.role_id = rp.role_id AND rp2.permission_id = new_p.id );

changeSet.author: brian
changeSet.comment: Update FullReportList query to filter reports by report_permission column
changeSet.sql: UPDATE stretchy_parameter SET parameter_sql = 'select r.id as report_id, r.report_name, r.report_type, r.report_subtype, r.report_category, rp.id as parameter_id, rp.report_parameter_name, p.parameter_name from stretchy_report r left join stretchy_report_parameter rp on rp.report_id = r.id left join stretchy_parameter p on p.id = rp.parameter_id where r.use_report is true and r.self_service_user_report = ''${isSelfServiceUser}'' and exists ( select ''f'' from m_appuser_role ur join m_role r on r.id = ur.role_id join m_role_permission rp on rp.role_id = r.id join m_permission p on p.id = rp.permission_id where ur.appuser_id = ${currentUserId} and (p.code in (''ALL_FUNCTIONS_READ'', ''ALL_FUNCTIONS'', ''REPORTING_SUPER_USER'') or p.code = r.report_permission) ) order by r.report_category, r.report_name, rp.id' WHERE parameter_name = 'FullReportList';

changeSet.author: brian
changeSet.comment: Update reportCategoryList query to filter reports by report_permission column
changeSet.sql: UPDATE stretchy_parameter SET parameter_sql = 'select r.id as report_id, r.report_name, r.report_type, r.report_subtype, r.report_category, rp.id as parameter_id, rp.report_parameter_name, p.parameter_name from stretchy_report r left join stretchy_report_parameter rp on rp.report_id = r.id left join stretchy_parameter p on p.id = rp.parameter_id where r.report_category = ''${reportCategory}'' and r.use_report is true and r.self_service_user_report = ''${isSelfServiceUser}'' and exists (select ''f'' from m_appuser_role ur join m_role r on r.id = ur.role_id join m_role_permission rp on rp.role_id = r.id join m_permission p on p.id = rp.permission_id where ur.appuser_id = ${currentUserId} and (p.code in (''ALL_FUNCTIONS_READ'', ''ALL_FUNCTIONS'', ''REPORTING_SUPER_USER'') or p.code = r.report_permission) ) order by r.report_category, r.report_name, rp.id' WHERE parameter_name = 'reportCategoryList';
